questions.a: Ferracad is an add-on (plugin) for AutoCAD that allows you to design reinforcement plans. It simplifies drawing rebar, inserting tags, and automatically generating steel schedules in Excel format.

questions.q: How do I get my Ferracad authorization code?
questions.a: After installation, launch AutoCAD and open the Ferracad palette. A message will appear indicating that the authorization code is invalid. Click OK, then go to http://ferracad.com/enregistrement to register. A code will be sent to you by email. Be sure to check your spam folder.

questions.q: What is the minimum system requirement to use Ferracad?
questions.a: Ferracad works with AutoCAD versions 2021 to 2023 and Microsoft Excel. Make sure both are installed on your computer before installing Ferracad.

questions.q: Is Ferracad compatible with all versions of AutoCAD?
questions.a: No, Ferracad is only compatible with specific versions of AutoCAD. The current version is compatible with AutoCAD 2021 to 2023. Earlier or later versions are not guaranteed to work.

questions.q: What should I do if my tags do not display correctly?
questions.a: Check that the bar you are tagging is a 2D polyline (LWPOLYLINE) and that it is on the layer named 'acier'. Also make sure the Ferracad palette is properly configured.
No, Ferracad requires an authorization code obtained through registration. This code is usually provided after purchasing or requesting a license.

questions.q: Which versions of AutoCAD and Excel are compatible with Ferracad?
questions.a: Ferracad works with AutoCAD versions 2021 to 2023 and Microsoft Excel. Other versions are not officially supported.

Launch the Ferracad installer and follow the instructions. Once installation is complete, open AutoCAD and go to the Ferracad palette. You will then need to enter an authorization code to activate the software.

questions.q: How do I open the Ferracad usage palette?
questions.a: Once AutoCAD is launched, click the button to open the Ferracad palette. This palette allows you to enter bar parameters, tags, scales, etc.

questions.q: What are WMF profile files used for?
questions.a: WMF (Windows Metafile) files contain bar diagrams used in the Excel schedule. They visually represent the shape of a bar in the table without linking to actual dimensions.

questions.q: What is the difference between AutoCAD and Ferracad?
questions.a: AutoCAD is a computer-aided design (CAD) software, while Ferracad is an add-on that adds specialized functions for drawing and tagging reinforced concrete bars, as well as exporting to Excel.
No, Ferracad is designed to work only on Windows, due to its dependency on AutoCAD for Windows and Microsoft Excel.

questions.q: Where can I find Ferracad configuration files?
questions.a: Configuration files (such as the Excel template) are usually installed in the Ferracad installation directory. You can specify or modify the Excel template path via the project properties dialog.
Yes, Ferracad allows grouping bars with the same characteristics (diameter, length, shape) using the group function in the palette. This helps manage quantities in the schedule.

questions.q: Excel export doesn’t work, what should I do?
questions.a: Check that the Excel template file is properly set in the project properties and that it includes the three sheets named 'GARDE', 'BORD', and 'RECAP'. Also ensure the required cells are named correctly and Excel is installed on your system.

features_description: Everything you need to manage, share, and secure your reinforcement drawings efficiently.
features_list_description1: Allows you to create diagrams of straight bars (beams, main reinforcements, etc.) directly in AutoCAD, ZWCAD, by clicking point by point to define the bar shape based on input parameters.
features_list_description2: Automatically generates closed rectangular stirrups, mainly used for transverse reinforcements in beams or columns.
features_list_description3: Draws circular stirrups suitable for round elements like circular columns or piles, with automatic calculation of lengths and bending radii.
features_list_description4: Assigns a unique tag number to each drawn bar, enabling their identification in the drawing and inclusion in the Excel schedule.
features_list_description5: Allows you to edit the information of an existing tag (number, group, quantity, diameter, etc.) without redrawing the bar, while keeping the link with the schedule.
features_list_description6: Inserts a distribution dimension indicating the number of bars between two points based on a defined spacing in the palette, automatically calculating the distances.
features_list_description7: Adds a bubble linked to the bar's label, which updates automatically when the label number changes.
features_list_description8: Adds a positioning symbol linked to a labeled bar, typically used in section views or detail drawings.
features_list_description9: Inserts a triangle at the end of a bar to visually indicate its termination, with automatic updates when changes are made.
features_list_description10: Allows positioning of labels in ordered columns within a frame, making the plan easier to read.
features_list_description11: Automatically generates the bar schedule in a structured Excel file, including lengths, quantities, diameters, and profile images.
features_list_description12: Directly opens the Excel file linked to the drawing to view or edit the generated schedule.
features_list_description13: Allows opening and editing the graphical representation of a bar profile in a dedicated DWG file.

comparaisonFerracad_1_avant: Manually drawing each bar with polylines and adding dimensions by hand. Risk of errors in lengths and shapes.
comparaisonFerracad_1_apres: Point-by-point drawing with automatic calculation of length and shape based on entered parameters.
comparaisonFerracad_2_avant: Manual drawing, often trial-and-error for bending radii. No automatic control.
comparaisonFerracad_2_apres: Automatic generation of rectangular or circular stirrups with correct bending.
comparaisonFerracad_3_avant: Manual labeling. Difficult to maintain, especially after modifications.
comparaisonFerracad_3_apres: Automatic numbering with updates in the drawing and Excel sheet.
comparaisonFerracad_4_avant: Redraw bars for any modification. High risk of errors.
comparaisonFerracad_4_apres: Direct modification of existing markers with global updates (drawing + Excel).
comparaisonFerracad_5_avant: Manual calculation of spacings, often error-prone.
comparaisonFerracad_5_apres: Automatic distribution with calculation and annotation of distances.
comparaisonFerracad_6_avant: Manual addition, not linked to bars. Risk of misalignment.
comparaisonFerracad_6_apres: Dynamic bubbles linked to bars, updated automatically.
comparaisonFerracad_7_avant: Manual addition, often forgotten or misplaced.
comparaisonFerracad_7_apres: Automatic addition and update of end bar triangles.
comparaisonFerracad_8_apres: Automatic alignment in neatly ordered columns.
comparaisonFerracad_9_avant: Manual creation of Excel table, with risk of omissions or errors.
comparaisonFerracad_9_apres: Automatic export of a structured Excel file with all necessary data.
comparaisonFerracad_10_apres: Centralized DWG file with modifiable and reusable profiles.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 15-05-2025

1. Introduction

As part of its operations, the site Ferracad collects and processes personal data. This privacy policy aims to inform users about the types of data collected, how it is used, and the rights they have.

2. Data collected

The following data may be collected during your use of the site:

  • First name, last name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Information related to a reservation or contact request
  • Browsing data (cookies, IP address)

3. Purposes of processing

These data are collected for:

  • Responding to your contact or reservation requests
  • Managing and improving our site
  • Sending you communications if you have consented
  • Complying with our legal obligations

4. Legal basis for processing

  • Your consent (forms, newsletter)
  • The performance of a contract (reservations)
  • Our legal obligations
  • Our legitimate interest (site improvement)

5. Retention period

  • Contact data: 3 years from last contact
  • Reservation data: 5 years (legal period)
  • Cookies: maximum 13 months

6. Recipients of data

The data is intended exclusively for Ferracad and is never sold. It may be shared with technical service providers (hosting, form handling tools) under confidentiality agreements.

7. Your rights

Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

  • Right of access
  • Right of rectification
  • Right to object
  • Right to erasure
  • Right to restriction of processing
  • Right to data portability

You can exercise these rights by contacting us at: support@ferracad.com .

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority.

8. Cookies

During your browsing, cookies may be placed on your device. You can modify your cookie preferences at any time via the management banner provided for that purpose.

General Terms and Conditions of Rental of Ferracad

1. Purpose

These General Terms and Conditions of Rental (hereinafter 'GTR') aim to define the rights and obligations of users and the Ferracad platform in the context of online rental of the Ferracad software extension, intended for CAD software.

2. Definitions

Ferracad Platform: the website or application Ferracad, allowing rental, download, and license management.

Ferracad (software): software extension developed to work with CAD software, made temporarily available through the platform.

Publisher: BMe, the developer and owner of the Ferracad software offered for rental.

User / Renter: any individual or legal entity having created an account on the platform and subscribed to the rental of Ferracad software.

License: temporary, personal, non-exclusive, and non-transferable right to use Ferracad.

3. Access to the service

  • Rental and use of Ferracad require creating a user account on the Ferracad platform.
  • The user must have a legal and compatible version of CAD software.
  • Access to Ferracad software is conditioned on prior payment of the rental period and license validation on the user’s account.

4. Rental terms

  • The rental is concluded for a minimum duration of 7 days specified during the order.
  • The license is automatically activated upon payment confirmation and remains valid until the end of the subscribed period.
  • At the expiration of the period, access to the software is automatically suspended unless renewed by the user.
  • No refund is possible after activation, except in case of technical failure attributable to the platform or publisher.

5. Use of Ferracad

  • The user agrees to use Ferracad according to its purpose, respecting applicable laws and intellectual property rights.
  • Any copying, distribution, resale, secondary rental, decompilation, or modification of the software is strictly prohibited.
  • Ferracad must not be used in an illegal environment or to circumvent CAD licenses.

6. Pricing and payment

  • Rental prices are indicated online on the platform and may vary according to duration, version, and options chosen.
  • Payments are made via secure methods offered on the platform (credit card, bank transfer, e-wallet, etc.).
  • The invoice is available in the user area once the order is confirmed.

7. Support and updates

8. Liability

  • The user is solely responsible for hardware compatibility, CAD software version, and file security.
  • The platform and publisher cannot be held liable for data loss, indirect damages, or service interruptions related to Ferracad usage.
  • In case of proven malfunction attributable to Ferracad, the platform’s liability is limited to the amount of the concerned rental period.

9. Intellectual property

Ferracad software remains the exclusive property of its publisher. Rental does not imply any transfer of ownership. The user acknowledges that all rights related to Ferracad (source code, interface, documentation, logo, etc.) are protected by copyright and international conventions.

10. Personal data and confidentiality

Data collected via the platform are used only for managing the user account, license, and billing. Ferracad commits to respecting the European GDPR regulation and Belgian legislation on personal data protection, ensuring user information security and confidentiality. Data is never transferred to third parties without prior consent. The user has rights to access, rectify, erase, limit, portability, and oppose in accordance with GDPR and applicable Belgian laws.

11. Termination and suspension
